## Checklist

### For All PRs
- [ ] I have read the [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) guidelines
- [ ] My changes follow the project's style guide
- [ ] I have tested that all links in my changes are valid
- [ ] I have not committed any secrets, credentials, or sensitive data

### For New Skill Files
- [ ] The skill file is at least 150 lines
- [ ] The skill includes all required sections:
  - [ ] When to Use
  - [ ] Prerequisites
  - [ ] Tools (with table)
  - [ ] Step-by-Step Procedure
  - [ ] Templates
  - [ ] Common Pitfalls
  - [ ] Legal Considerations
  - [ ] Further Reading
- [ ] The skill follows the naming convention (`kebab-case.md`)
- [ ] Code examples are tested and functional
- [ ] The skill does not duplicate existing content

### For Existing Skill Updates
- [ ] I have verified the updated content is accurate
- [ ] I have updated the "Further Reading" section if references have changed
- [ ] I have not changed the overall structure or section ordering

## Testing

- [ ] Ran the CI pipeline locally
- [ ] Verified all markdown renders correctly
- [ ] Checked all links manually
- [ ] Tested code examples in the skill file
